task.description: Implement EXT-04 according to src/design/ext-04-variable-transformer.md. Add support for optional CEL edge transform expressions evaluated when traversing an edge. Ensure activation-time validation rejects invalid CEL syntax (PD-02/PD-06 path). At runtime evaluate transform after EE-09 task output merge and before next-node activation using EE-05-equivalent CEL context. Require transform output to be a JSON object merged via EE-09 semantics; if result is non-object or CEL runtime evaluation fails, route to EE-10 error handling. Treat empty transform expression as no-op. Add/adjust tests for acceptance criteria and edge cases including missing-variable CEL runtime error and empty-transform pass-through. Run mandatory validations: zig build, zig build test, zig build migrate, and error-set check before completion.
acceptance_criteria: zig build, zig build test, and zig build migrate exit 0
Invalid CEL transform syntax is rejected at definition activation
Runtime transform executes in correct order (post-EE-09 merge, pre-next-node activation)
Non-object or runtime CEL transform failures route through EE-10
Empty transform expression behaves as no-op
Tests cover EXT-04 acceptance criteria and edge cases

result.summary: Implemented EXT-04 edge transform support across definition validation and runtime transition flow. Added optional GraphEdge.transform persistence/copy wiring, activation-time transform syntax validation in definition lifecycle paths, runtime transform execution on traversed task/service-task edges after EE-09 merge and before next-node activation, and EE-10 routing for transform evaluation and non-object result failures. Added/updated unit coverage for transform validation and runtime edge cases, including missing-variable evaluation failure and empty-transform no-op.
